dataset: Santos-Lopez et al. 2021, eLife 10:e70676, Figure 1 source data 2

analysis_spec.X: median log2 MIC at day 3 under the same antibiotic used for experimental evolution
analysis_spec.R_future: median log2 MIC at day 12 under that antibiotic
analysis_spec.technical_replicates: 3 MIC readings collapsed by median before log2 transform
analysis_spec.out_of_sample: 3 folds, each holding out population replicate index 1, 2 or 3 across all histories and both antibiotics
analysis_spec.models: ridge alpha=1 fixed; state=X+antibiotic; history=X+antibiotic+six-level ancestral history
analysis_spec.permutation: 5000 permutations of H within antibiotic × population-replicate strata
analysis_spec.bootstrap: 5000 stratified resamples of independent lines within antibiotic

secondary_prespecified_guard_diagnostics.interpretation: both independent drug-selection arms preserve the sign of the primary gain; these are guard diagnostics and do not replace the frozen primary rule

source_data_role: public pre-existing data opened only after the 2026-08-11 prediction freeze; external blind validation, not newly collected prospective data
